title: Compute auxiliary function R(p)
action: Implement the integral I(p) defined in the mathematical formulation section. Use numerical integration (adaptive quadrature) to compute I(p) for the required p values corresponding to the (111) 0° and 120° half‑dislocations. Transform the result to R(p) = √3 · p · e^p · I(p).

title: Compute auxiliary function f(eta,sigma)
action: Using the analytical definition of |f(η,σ)| and the algebraic relations for η and σ given in the mathematical formulation, compute its numerical value at μ=0.343 for the (111) 90° and 30° dislocations.

title: Compute elastic limits for all dislocation types
action: Using the explicit elastic‑limit formulas given in the mathematical formulation, together with the previously computed R(p) and |f|, evaluate the normalized elastic limit τ_el/G for the six dislocation types: (010) 90°, (010) 0°, (111) 0° half, (111) 120° half, (111) 90°, (111) 30°.  Use the fixed parameters s/b=0.456 and μ=0.343 and the geometric data listed in the formulation.  Write the results into the specified CSV file.
description: CSV with two columns: dislocation_type (str) and tau_over_G (float).  No header row; rows appear in the fixed order: (010)90°, (010)0°, (111)0°half, (111)120°half, (111)90°, (111)30°.
output_schema: Columns: dislocation_type (str), tau_over_G (float). No header row; first row corresponds to (010)90°.
